biggest_catch: You don't get paid until the friend's checking account has stayed open, active, and in good standing for a full 90 days - the bonus lands by the month-end of that 90-day period.
catches: $25 to the referrer and $25 to the friend for each new member who opens a checking account.
Friend must present the referral form at the time of account opening (with the referrer's name and phone number).
Friend's checking account must remain open, active, and in good standing for at least 90 days; bonus rewarded by the month end of the 90 days.
No referral cap stated on the flyer.
Employees of FirstCal FCU are not eligible; other restrictions may apply; promotion can be cancelled at any time.

steps: Write your name and phone number on the referral flyer.
Give the flyer to your friend; they present it when opening a checking account.
Friend's checking account must remain open, active, and in good standing for 90 days.
You and your friend each receive $25 by the month end of the 90-day period.
timing: Rewarded by the month end of the friend's 90-day open/active/good-standing period.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Rewarded by the month end of the friend's 90-day open/active/good-standing period. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
Volume constraint noted in terms: cap stated on the flyer — plan referral count against the cap, not the calendar.
